title: Under hall
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：under　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 under 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the builder kept the beam ① under the old law at the wall, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the beam had been left ② under the table in the hall, and nobody had asked a single question. The builder had come to the site two months earlier and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The plan for October 1970 puts it plainer. It was done ③ under the name of his brother, and the assistant who kept the beam had laid it ④ under the care of the nurse twice before the winter came; nothing in the site was ever done under the name of his brother in those days. The assistant wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ under the weight of the snow, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ under the eye of the doctor; he was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was that the beam be laid ⑦ under the load of the cart, and that the names be written ⑧ under the cover of the desk. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried under the load of the cart.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986 she kept the beam ⑨ under the old law again when nobody else would, and ⑩ under the table in the hall, she said in 1988, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the beam in the same wall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot what had been done under the table in the hall.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…之下（表时间：under the old law）
B. prep. 在…之下（表处所：under the table in the hall）
C. prep. 受…支配（表方式／状态：under the name of his brother）
D. prep. 受…支配（引出施动者或相关的人：be laid under the care of the nurse）
E. prep. 在…之下（表原因：under the weight of the snow）
F. prep. 受…支配（表对象／目的：under the eye of the doctor）
G. prep. 在…之下（表工具／材料：under the load of the cart）
H. prep. 受…支配（表载体／处所：written under the cover of the desk）

items.q: under the table in the hall
under the name of his brother
under the care of the nurse
under the weight of the snow
under the eye of the doctor
under the load of the cart
under the cover of the desk
under the table in the hall, she said

answers.why: under 意为“在…之下”，此处引出时间 the old law（旧法之下），说明那件短短的横梁是在何时留下的。
under 意为“在…之下”，此处引出处所 the table in the hall（厅里的桌子下面），说明东西被放在何处。
under 意为“受…支配”，此处引出方式或状态 the name of his brother（他兄弟的名下），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
under 意为“受…支配”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 护士的照料之下：be laid under the care of the nurse。
under 意为“在…之下”，此处引出原因 the weight of the snow（积雪的重压），说明整件事由何而起。
under 意为“受…支配”，此处引出对象或目的 the eye of the doctor（大夫的看护之下）。
under 意为“在…之下”，此处引出工具或材料 the load of the cart（车上的重负）。
under 意为“受…支配”，此处引出载体 the cover of the desk（桌面之下）：names written under the cover of the desk。
under 意为“在…之下”，1986 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件短短的横梁，此处仍引出时间 the old law。
under 意为“在…之下”，母亲 1988 年那句话引出的仍是那一处厅里的桌子下面。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年旧法之下前后，施工员把那件短短的横梁留在了墙体。（under the old law）
那件短短的横梁被放在厅里的桌子下面，谁也没有过问。（under the table in the hall）
整件事是他兄弟的名下做成的，施工图上写得明白。（under the name of his brother）
入冬之前，那件短短的横梁已经由护士的照料之下砌过两回。（be laid under the care of the nurse）
叔叔说，整件事是由积雪的重压起的。（under the weight of the snow）
他说，家里从来没有人为大夫的看护之下做过这件事。（under the eye of the doctor）
answers: In 1976 the builder kept the beam under the old law at the wall.
The beam had been left under the table in the hall, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done under the name of his brother, or so the plan says.
The beam had been laid under the care of the nurse twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun under the weight of the snow.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it under the eye of the doctor.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 under 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the builder kept the beam under the old law, and nobody forgot it.
The beam had been left under the table in the hall for three months.
The work was done under the name of his brother, as it always was in those days.
The beam had been laid under the care of the nurse twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the beam under the old law again when nobody else would.
The whole site never forgot what had been done under the table in the hall.
